hook.en: "If I win, I will…" vs "If I won, I would…" — the first person believes it can happen; the second is dreaming. Small changes in structure change the whole meaning.
hook.bm: "If I win, I will…" berbanding "If I won, I would…" — orang pertama percaya ia boleh berlaku; orang kedua hanya berangan. Perubahan kecil dalam struktur mengubah keseluruhan makna.

bigIdeas.en: Conditionals: zero (facts), first (real future), second (unreal present), third (unreal past).
bigIdeas.bm: Conditionals: zero (fakta), first (masa depan yang mungkin), second (andaian masa kini), third (andaian masa lalu).

bigIdeas.en: The passive (be + V3) focuses on the action or the receiver, not the doer.
bigIdeas.bm: Ayat pasif (be + V3) memberi tumpuan kepada tindakan atau penerima, bukan pelaku.

bigIdeas.en: Reported speech moves tenses one step back and changes pronouns and time words.
bigIdeas.bm: Cakap pindah mengundurkan kala satu langkah dan mengubah kata ganti serta kata masa.

definition.en: A sentence with a condition (if-clause) and a result.
definition.bm: Ayat dengan syarat (klausa if) dan akibat.

definition.en: Object becomes subject; be + past participle (The cake was eaten).
definition.bm: Objek menjadi subjek; be + past participle (The cake was eaten).

definition.en: Reporting what someone said without quotation marks.
definition.bm: Melaporkan kata-kata seseorang tanpa tanda petik.

definition.en: Moving the tense one step back in reported speech (is → was).
definition.bm: Mengundurkan kala satu langkah dalam cakap pindah (is → was).

question.en: Report: Aina said, "I am revising my notes now."
question.bm: Tukar ke cakap pindah: Aina said, "I am revising my notes now."

steps.en: Pronoun: I → she. Tense: am revising → was revising.
steps.bm: Kata ganti: I → she. Kala: am revising → was revising.

steps.en: Time word: now → then. Possessive: my → her.
steps.bm: Kata masa: now → then. Kata milik: my → her.

answer.en: Aina said (that) she was revising her notes then.
answer.bm: Aina said (that) she was revising her notes then.

prompt.en: If you heat water to 100°C, it ___.
prompt.bm: If you heat water to 100°C, it ___.

explanation.en: Zero conditional for scientific facts: present + present.
explanation.bm: Zero conditional untuk fakta sains: present + present.

prompt.en: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the match.
prompt.bm: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the match.

explanation.en: First conditional: if + present, will + base verb.
explanation.bm: First conditional: if + present, will + kata kerja asal.

prompt.en: If I ___ a bird, I would fly to Sabah.
prompt.bm: If I ___ a bird, I would fly to Sabah.

explanation.en: Second conditional (unreal): if + past ("were" for all persons in formal English).
explanation.bm: Second conditional (andaian): if + past ("were" untuk semua subjek dalam bahasa formal).

prompt.en: Passive: "The window ___ (break) by the ball yesterday."
prompt.bm: Pasif: "The window ___ (break) by the ball yesterday."

explanation.en: Past passive: was/were + V3.
explanation.bm: Pasif lampau: was/were + V3.

prompt.en: Which sentence is passive?
prompt.bm: Ayat manakah ayat pasif?

explanation.en: be + V3, with the doer after "by".
explanation.bm: be + V3, dengan pelaku selepas "by".

options.en: The letter was written by Mei Ling.
options.bm: The letter was written by Mei Ling.

prompt.en: He said, "I am tired." → He said that he ___ tired.
prompt.bm: He said, "I am tired." → He said that he ___ tired.

explanation.en: Backshift: am → was.
explanation.bm: Anjakan kala: am → was.

prompt.en: The girl ___ won the prize is my cousin.
prompt.bm: The girl ___ won the prize is my cousin.

explanation.en: "Who" for people.
explanation.bm: "Who" untuk orang.

prompt.en: This is the house ___ I was born. (relative word)
prompt.bm: This is the house ___ I was born. (kata relatif)

explanation.en: "Where" for places.
explanation.bm: "Where" untuk tempat.

prompt.en: Match each conditional with its use.
prompt.bm: Padankan conditional dengan kegunaannya.

explanation.en: Choose the conditional by how real the situation is.
explanation.bm: Pilih conditional berdasarkan sejauh mana situasi itu nyata.

prompt.en: If she had left earlier, she ___ the bus.
prompt.bm: If she had left earlier, she ___ the bus.

explanation.en: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + V3.
explanation.bm: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + V3.

prompt.en: Change to passive: "The council builds new parks every year."
prompt.bm: Tukar ke pasif: "The council builds new parks every year."

explanation.en: Present passive: am/is/are + V3; plural "parks" → are.
explanation.bm: Pasif kini: am/is/are + V3; "parks" jamak → are.

options.en: New parks are built by the council every year.
options.bm: New parks are built by the council every year.

options.en: New parks were built by the council every year.
options.bm: New parks were built by the council every year.

options.en: New parks is built by the council every year.
options.bm: New parks is built by the council every year.

options.en: New parks are build by the council every year.
options.bm: New parks are build by the council every year.

prompt.en: Why is the passive often used in science reports?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah ayat pasif sering digunakan dalam laporan sains?

explanation.en: E.g. "The solution was heated for five minutes."
explanation.bm: Cth. "The solution was heated for five minutes."

options.en: The process matters more than who did it
options.bm: Proses lebih penting daripada siapa yang melakukannya

prompt.en: Arrange the steps to change direct to reported speech.
prompt.bm: Susun langkah menukar cakap ajuk kepada cakap pindah.

explanation.en: Follow these steps in order to avoid missing a change.
explanation.bm: Ikut langkah ini supaya tiada perubahan tertinggal.

items.en: Choose a reporting verb (said, told, asked)
items.bm: Pilih kata kerja pelapor (said, told, asked)

prompt.en: She asked, "Where do you live?" → She asked me where ___.
prompt.bm: She asked, "Where do you live?" → She asked me where ___.

explanation.en: Reported questions use statement word order and no question mark.
explanation.bm: Soalan dalam cakap pindah menggunakan susunan ayat penyata dan tiada tanda soal.

prompt.en: Select ALL correct time-word changes in reported speech.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA perubahan kata masa yang betul dalam cakap pindah.

explanation.en: "Now" usually becomes "then".
explanation.bm: "Now" biasanya menjadi "then".

prompt.en: Rashid, ___ father is a pilot, travels a lot.
prompt.bm: Rashid, ___ father is a pilot, travels a lot.

explanation.en: "Whose" shows possession.
explanation.bm: "Whose" menunjukkan pemilikan.

prompt.en: "If I had studied harder, I would have passed." What does this tell us?
prompt.bm: "If I had studied harder, I would have passed." Apakah maksud ayat ini?

explanation.en: Third conditional describes the opposite of what happened.
explanation.bm: Third conditional menerangkan sebaliknya daripada apa yang berlaku.

options.en: The speaker did not study hard and did not pass
options.bm: Penutur tidak belajar bersungguh-sungguh dan tidak lulus

prompt.en: Which passive sentence is MOST appropriate for a school notice?
prompt.bm: Ayat pasif manakah PALING sesuai untuk notis sekolah?

explanation.en: Formal notices use the passive to sound polite and impersonal.
explanation.bm: Notis rasmi menggunakan ayat pasif supaya kedengaran sopan dan tidak peribadi.

options.en: Students are reminded to wear their name tags.
options.bm: Students are reminded to wear their name tags.

options.en: We remind you, students, wear name tags!
options.bm: We remind you, students, wear name tags!

prompt.en: Find the error: "He told that he will come tomorrow."
prompt.bm: Cari kesalahan: "He told that he will come tomorrow."

explanation.en: "Tell" needs an object (told me); backshift will → would; change time words.
explanation.bm: "Tell" memerlukan objek (told me); anjakan will → would; tukar kata masa.

options.en: told → said; will → would; tomorrow → the next day
options.bm: told → said; will → would; tomorrow → the next day

prompt.en: Combine: "I met a man. He had climbed Everest."
prompt.bm: Gabungkan: "I met a man. He had climbed Everest."

explanation.en: "Who" replaces the person subject "He".
explanation.bm: "Who" menggantikan subjek orang "He".

options.en: I met a man who had climbed Everest.
options.bm: I met a man who had climbed Everest.

options.en: I met a man which had climbed Everest.
options.bm: I met a man which had climbed Everest.

options.en: I met a man whose had climbed Everest.
options.bm: I met a man whose had climbed Everest.

options.en: I met a man where had climbed Everest.
options.bm: I met a man where had climbed Everest.
